rationale: The macOS plug-in view hosts (plugin_view_host_mac.mm) now paint each display-link tick one main-queue turn after its idle work, hold CPU repaints requested during idle work for that paint half, flush the Core Animation transaction before presenting a frame whose size or scale changed, and add width/height args to the plugin_editor_frame trace span. This changes only when an already-rendered editor frame is presented relative to host geometry messages; renderer selection, Skia/Dawn backends, render assets, design import, Chromium and packaging are untouched, so no authority moves.
